streamelements.isConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to StreamElements right now.

streamelements.sendTestEvent.description: Fakes a StreamElements event inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to StreamElements and it works without a connection.
streamelements.sendTestEvent.returns: true when the test event was sent, false when the kind is unknown.

streamelements.getUserPoints.description: Looks up how many StreamElements loyalty points a viewer has. Needs your StreamElements token on the Donations page; fails with an error otherwise.

parameters.user: The viewer's name, like "CoolViewer". A leading @ is fine. Needed.

streamelements.addUserPoints.description: Gives a viewer StreamElements loyalty points. Use a minus number to take points away. Needs your StreamElements token; fails with an error otherwise.

parameters.amount: How many points to add, like 100. Use a minus number, like -50, to take points away.

streamelements.getTips.description: Gets your latest StreamElements tips. Needs your StreamElements token; fails with an error otherwise.

parameters.count: Optional. How many tips to get. Default 5.

streamelements.getTips.returns: A list of tips. Each has user, amount, currency, formattedAmount (like "$5.00"), message and createdAt.

streamelements.getTipLeaderboard.description: Gets the viewers who tipped you the most on StreamElements. Needs your StreamElements token; fails with an error otherwise.

parameters.count: Optional. How many people to get. Default 5.

streamelements.getTipLeaderboard.returns: A list of the top tippers. Each has user and total (how much they tipped).

streamelements.getPointsLeaderboard.description: Gets the viewers with the most StreamElements loyalty points. Needs your StreamElements token; fails with an error otherwise.

parameters.count: Optional. How many people to get. Default 5.

streamelements.getPointsLeaderboard.returns: A list of the viewers with the most points. Each has user and points.

streamelements.isLive.description: Checks whether StreamElements says your stream is live on any platform it watches. Works with the connection on.
streamelements.isLive.returns: true when live, false when offline, null before StreamElements has said.

streamelements.say.description: Sends a chat message as the StreamElements bot. The bot must be in your chat. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.

parameters.message: What the bot should say. Needed.

streamelements.getCounter.description: Reads a StreamElements chatbot counter, like a death counter. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.
streamelements.getCounter.returns: The counter's value as a number.

streamelements.overlayAction.description: Controls your StreamElements overlays. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.

streamelements.setSessionValue.description: Changes one StreamElements session value, like the tip goal. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.

streamelements.getUserRank.description: Looks up a viewer's place on your StreamElements points list. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.
streamelements.getUserRank.returns: Their place as a number (1 is the top).

streamelements.bulkPoints.description: Adds (or sets) the same points for many viewers at once. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.

parameters.users: A list of names, or one text with names separated by commas or spaces. Needed.

streamelements.createTip.description: Adds a tip to your StreamElements tip list (for example one paid elsewhere) so goals and leaderboards count it. No money moves. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.

streamelements.getPendingTips.description: Gets the StreamElements tips waiting for a moderator. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.
streamelements.getPendingTips.returns: A list of tips. Each has id, user, amount, currency, formattedAmount and message.

streamelements.getCheerLeaderboard.description: Gets the people who cheered the most bits. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.
streamelements.getCheerLeaderboard.returns: A list. Each has user and total.

streamelements.getStoreItems.description: Lists the items in your StreamElements loyalty store. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.
streamelements.getStoreItems.returns: A list. Each has id, name, enabled, cost and stock (-1 for no limit).

streamelements.setStoreItem.description: Changes a loyalty store item: on or off, its price or how many are left. Leave out what should stay. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.

parameters.item: The item's name or id. Needed.
parameters.cost: Optional. The new price in points.

streamelements.setStoreItem.returns: The item after the change: id, name, enabled, cost and stock.

streamelements.completeRedemption.description: Marks a StreamElements store redemption as done. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.

parameters.redemptionId: The redemption's id, like the trigger's redemptionId. Needed.

streamelements.refundRedemption.description: Cancels a StreamElements store redemption and gives the points back. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.

streamelements.getPlayingSong.description: Gets the StreamElements song request playing now. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.
streamelements.getPlayingSong.returns: id, title, url, user and duration, or null when nothing plays.

streamelements.addSong.description: Adds a song to your StreamElements song request queue. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.

parameters.video: A YouTube link, video id or search words. Needed.

streamelements.addSong.returns: The queued song: id, title and url.

streamelements.replayLatest.description: Asks StreamElements to send its newest real event of a kind again, to test alerts end to end. Needs your StreamElements JWT token; fails with an error otherwise.
streamelements.replayLatest.returns: The replayed event's id, or "" when there was none.
